Superannuation (Departing Australia Superannuation Payments Tax) Amendment Bill (No. 2) 2016 - Second Reading - Speed things along
Superannuation (Departing Australia Superannuation Payments Tax) Amendment Bill (No. 2) 2016 - Third Reading - Speed things along

The bill reduces the tax rate on superannuation payments for departing working holiday-makers from 95% to 65%, effective 1 July 2017, costing $55 million in revenue. This change is part of a government package negotiated with Senate crossbenchers and the Greens to lower the income tax rate for working holiday-makers to 15%.

The speaker argued the backpacker tax has devolved into a chaotic farce, citing a joint statement from Treasurer Scott Morrison and Senator Di Natale, and criticised the government for a $155 million backtrack on the policy, which they said contradicts its claims of fiscal responsibility.
